placeholders.<hash>: the tree hash a receipt names
placeholders.<verdict>: ok, or failed with the failed steps
placeholders.<step>: a gate step: import, check, strict, lint, arch, boot or test
placeholders.<reason>: the reason field of a godotkit JSON line
placeholders.<reach change>: max files reached now and its change against the base commit
placeholders.<count>: a finding count from the survey
placeholders.<file contents>: the full text of a file to write

placeholders.<id>: an asset id, such as door-mc5b
placeholders.<endpoint>: the provider's model or endpoint id
placeholders.<prompt>: the prompt the file was generated from
placeholders.<request id>: the provider's job or request id
placeholders.<status>: a folded status: pending_review, retake, approved, final, rejected or deprecated
placeholders.<next step>: what happens to the asset next
